sources.title: Generative models - OpenAI
sources.snippet: This post describes four projects that share a common theme of enhancing or using generative models, a branch of unsupervised learning techniques in machine learning. In addition to describing our work, this post will tell you a bit more about generative models: what they are, why they are important, and where they might be going.

sources.title: AI 3D Model Generator — Create & Animate 3D Characters - Tripo AI
sources.snippet: Tripo AI is an all-in-one AI 3D model generator that creates production-ready 3D models from images or text prompts in seconds. It covers the full pipeline — generation, texturing, rigging, segmentation, and mesh optimization — in a single platform.
